content:
Production Computer Vision system for biometric identity verification (eKYC) extended into face-based attendance.

The pipeline verifies a person against enrolled face embeddings, then records attendance events in real time—reducing manual check-in and identity fraud for workplace and institutional deployments.

**Highlights:**
• **eKYC** — face matching for identity authentication.
• **Face Attendance** — automated check-in/out from the same verification stack.
• **Production Integration** — embedded into operational workflows beyond a demo prototype.

h2: Tay Ninh Government Investment Project Platform
content:
Managing government investment projects (Đầu tư công) is critical for the Department of Finance of Tay Ninh Province. To address the complexity of overseeing project processes, documents, plans, and capital, we built a specialized Government Investment Project Management Web Platform.

Its key AI capability is Document OCR integrated with Large Language Models (LLM): scanned contracts, financial reports, and project dossiers are automatically processed so critical data is captured, categorized, and managed with high efficiency.

**OCR Capabilities:**
• **Automatic report extraction** from scanned government investment documents.
• **Table understanding** — structured tabular data recovered from complex layouts.
• **Figure handling** — charts, diagrams, and visual elements processed alongside text.
• **LLM post-processing** — normalized fields ready for project oversight workflows.

MyMeeting automatically processes meeting audio into searchable transcripts and concise summaries—turning long recordings into actionable records for government agencies and enterprises.

Built on a Speech-to-Text (ASR) pipeline with model fine-tuning for domain speech, then layered with summarization so stakeholders get both full transcripts and short digests without manual note-taking.

**Highlights:**
• **ASR transcription** — meeting audio → full text transcript.
• **Auto-summarization** — key points and decisions extracted from the transcript.
• **ASR fine-tuning** — adapted speech models for better accuracy on real meeting audio.
• **End-to-end workflow** — from upload/recording through transcript and summary delivery.

A database-first Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that scales to millions of documents with constant memory usage. Built with FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector, and multimodal AI capabilities.

**Key Advantages:**
• **Database-First Architecture** - Zero in-memory embeddings, all vectors stored in PostgreSQL with pgvector.
• **Advanced Retrieval** - Recency-weighted search with dual embedding strategy.
• **Multimodal Capabilities** - High-speed PDF processing with PyMuPDF, image OCR using Gemini Vision API.
• **Production-Ready** - Async initialization, Google OAuth authentication with JWT tokens, and modern React + Ant Design frontend.

Sàn Việc Làm Cao Bằng is the official digital employment platform of the Cao Bang Provincial Employment Service Center, operated under the Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs. It connects job seekers with employers across the province as a trusted channel for labor market information.

The platform offers public employment services such as job listings, career counseling, labor supply, vocational training guidance, and unemployment insurance support. Workers and businesses can search opportunities, post recruitment needs, and stay informed about the local labor market online—helping reduce barriers to employment and strengthen economic development in Cao Bang.

We are excited to introduce a comprehensive EdTech application designed to deliver flexible and engaging learning experiences for users while providing powerful administrative control.

This platform is structured into two distinct, yet interconnected, sides: Admin Console and End-User Experience with dynamic EdTech Engines for lessons, exams, and custom content creation.

The "Paperless Meeting Management" application is a comprehensive digital solution designed to modernize and streamline the organization and administration of meetings within government agencies and enterprises. Built using .NET Core 8.0, ABP Framework, ReactJS, MariaDB, Docker, and Azure cloud infrastructure. Complements MyMeeting AI workflows for transcription and summarization.

A Management application that can track and calculate the effort of work items. Helps managers and business teams. In the first version, it focuses on managing development teams, works with Azure DevOps.

Experience explosive fun with the Java-based Bomber game! Engage in thrilling gameplay as you strategically navigate through maze-like levels, planting bombs to destroy obstacles and outsmart your opponents.
